About the job

Example Financial is hiring a Senior Python Data Engineer for a 6-month contract (possible extension) to modernize our risk data platform. This is a hybrid role in Toronto, ON.

What you will do

  • Build and maintain ETL pipelines on AWS (Glue, S3, Lambda).
  • Model data in Snowflake and write complex SQL.
  • Work with the risk team to deliver reports in Power BI.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of Python experience
  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills
  • Experience with Airflow is an asset

About us

Example Financial is a fictional lender serving Canadians since 1990.
